verdict.rationale: AgentMail is a hosted, API-first email provider, so offline access with later sync is a fair question for an email product. However, the evidence documents no offline mode, local cache, or reconnect sync in AgentMail itself. Its IMAP/SMTP support (agentmail-docs-8) lets third-party clients like Thunderbird connect, but any offline behavior there would come from those external clients, a user-side workaround that earns no credit.
